claim_boundary: Validates the new row-order-invariant P4 evaluator identity on the complete 67-task Adult/Sick schedule and unchanged 0.05 stability gates using native Windows 11, Python 3.11, and the recorded RTX 5080. It does not evaluate generator quality, retroactively alter historical pilot evidence, generalize to other GPUs, or admit Official Results.
